mapper.sql: select k.chunk_id, k.doc_id, k.chunk_index, k.content, k.content_hash, k.page_no, k.clause_no, k.char_start, k.char_end, k.create_by, k.create_time, k.update_by, k.update_time, k.remark, d.doc_name as doc_name, d.doc_type as doc_type from jc_kb_chunk k left join jc_kb_document d on d.doc_id = k.doc_id
mapper.select: where k.doc_id = #{docId} and k.del_flag = '0' order by k.chunk_index
mapper.insert:
insert into jc_kb_chunk (doc_id, chunk_index, content, content_hash, page_no, clause_no, char_start, char_end, create_by, create_time) values
(#{item.docId}, #{item.chunkIndex}, #{item.content}, #{item.contentHash}, #{item.pageNo}, #{item.clauseNo}, #{item.charStart}, #{item.charEnd}, #{item.createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update jc_kb_chunk set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from jc_kb_chunk where del_flag = '0'
